name: Detroit

neighborhoods.name: Midtown
neighborhoods.homes: older apartment buildings and new complexes

neighborhoods.name: Corktown
neighborhoods.homes: row houses and small apartment buildings

housing: Most Detroit renters live in rented single-family houses and two-family flats, with apartment buildings mainly in Midtown and Downtown.

localRules.text: Detroit rental properties must be registered and pass an inspection for a Certificate of Compliance; where there is no certificate, tenants can pay rent into the city's Rental Escrow Program.

tenantHelp.name: Detroit Rental Escrow Program
tenantHelp.what: city program to hold rent while repairs are made

climate: Test the furnace and look for leaks, damp basements and drafty windows; winters are cold and many houses are old.
fact: In Detroit you can ask the landlord to show the rental's Certificate of Compliance, which must be posted at the property.
